mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, which in turn results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the FEDFUNDS rate increased by more than 0.5% within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP over the past quarter indicates strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 50% of the quarters where real GDP increased.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3 percentage points within the last month signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to increased wage pressures and inflation, negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the unemployment rate decreased by more than 0.3 percentage points within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% within the last two months signals increased economic activity and corporate output, which boosts investor confidence and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where industrial production increased by more than 1% within the last two months.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts and real GDP indicates a robust economic expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 50% of the quarters where both housing starts and real GDP increased.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 2% and the consumer price index increases by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals inflationary pressure, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL increase > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the federal funds rate was above 2% and the CPI increased by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls combined with an increase in the unemployment rate signals a weakening labor market, which can lead to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS decrease and UNRATE increase in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of the instances where nonfarm payrolls decreased and the unemployment rate increased.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail and food services sales combined with a decrease in housing starts indicates a contraction in consumer demand, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST decrease in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 50% of the instances where both retail and food services sales and housing starts decreased.
